fomod.Name: RPA Fixes - Raider Power Armor Ladder
fomod.Author: RPA_Fixes
fomod.Description: Rebalances Rivets and Rage (Scrapper), CW Raider T-45 and Rust King (Raider Brute) power armor into a clear ladder: Raider < Scrapper < Raider T-45 < Brute. The Brute gets a T-51 style lining upgrade path (B-F). All three show the raider power armor icon in FIS. Optional debug plugin adds free Chem Station recipes for every piece.
